name: Complete Forbidden pc-Minor Basis for COM Tope Graphs
statement: A finite partial cube is a COM tope graph exactly when it has no pc-minor in $\mathcal Q^-$. Every member of $\mathcal Q^-$ contains a nongated antipodal subgraph and every proper pc-minor avoids the whole family.
proof: The COM tope-graph theorem equates membership with gating of every antipodal subgraph and with avoidance of $\mathcal Q^-$. Each displayed obstruction has a nongated antipodal subgraph. If a proper pc-minor contained another member of $\mathcal Q^-$, transitivity would put that member as a proper pc-minor of the original obstruction, contradicting the obstruction-antichain lemma. Hence the basis is complete and pc-minimal.
